demo.morningHint: Reset the mission to the seeded morning.
demo.headacheHint: Adds the headache report and the cabin sensor reading.
demo.watchHint: Jumps to 20 seconds before the watch raises the alarm.

check.label: Daily check · {n} of {total}
check.prefilled: Showing your last value. Change it if today is different.
check.typeHint: Type the number or use the keypad. Enter goes to the next one.
check.scaleHint: Tap an answer, or press a number from 1 to 5.
check.tapZone: Tap a body zone to see what feeds it.
check.noIndicators: Nothing is measured for this zone yet.

findings.title: Findings
findings.none: Nothing needs your attention right now.
findings.noneHint: KAWSAY cross-checks your readings every time one comes in.
findings.onBoard: Resolved on board — no need to wait for Earth.
findings.escalates: This one also goes to the flight surgeon.
findings.gotIt: Got it, I'll do it today
findings.noted: Noted at {time}. We'll look again at tomorrow's check.
findings.ifNotText: KAWSAY adds this to the flight surgeon brief and keeps watching.

brief.heading: Brief · Sol {day} · {crew}
brief.readyText: One screen, readable in 30 seconds. Goes out with the next downlink.
brief.queuedText: Nothing new since {time}. A new brief is built when something changes.
brief.conjunctionText: Brief stored on this device. KAWSAY keeps the loop running on board.
brief.nothingChanged: Nothing changed since the last brief.
brief.footerDecision: Earth's answer cannot arrive before {time}. Keep following the steps on board.

environment.hint: Sets gravity and the delay to Earth used by the brief.

watch.title: Watch data
watch.todayHint: Heart rate through the day, with what you were doing underneath. A knot marks each alert.
watch.cannotHint: They come from your daily check.
rules: Heart rate 110 or more while resting, for 1 min · Watch
Heart rate 110 or more while resting, for 5 min · Act
Heart rate 130 or more while resting, for 2 min · Act now
Heart rate below 40 while awake and resting, for 5 min · Act
Blood oxygen below 92 % for 3 min · Act
Blood oxygen below 88 % for 1 min · Act now
watch.rulesNote: These limits are prototype values, not NASA figures. A high heart rate during exercise is not an alert.
watch.noAlerts: No alerts so far. Your watch is checking every 5 seconds.

alarm.countdown: No answer in {time} and KAWSAY alerts the crew.
alarm.usual: Your usual resting rate is {low} to {high}.

respond.notRuledOut: Not ruled out: a rhythm problem. If it does not settle, the crew medical officer and Earth are told.
respond.recheckHint: Stay resting. Keep the watch on.
respond.dontWait: Earth is {min} minutes away. Do not wait for the answer to act.
respond.noEarth: No contact with Earth during conjunction. The crew medical officer decides.
